title: Meta Updates Terms to Remove Potential AI Web Scraping Language
excerpt: Following public backlash, Meta has updated its commercial terms to remove phrasing that implied it could scrape news sites for AI training.
body_html:
Meta has updated its terms of service following public backlash regarding how it gathers data for artificial intelligence development. The company removed specific language from its commercial terms page that suggested it could scrape content from websites, including news outlets, to train its AI models.

The disputed phrasing previously indicated that Meta could utilize content from any domains, web pages, or URLs to provide, develop, and improve its systems. With the recent update, this specific authorization no longer appears on the commercial terms page.
